plugins.description: Claude Loops: repeatable, verified workflows around the model. Scaffold a claude-loops/ workspace and drive loops (create, run, status, stop, remove) via slash commands.

plugins.description: Write or rewrite technical text with ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, one word one meaning, active voice, condition before command. Re-published from AminBlg/SimpleEnglish, pinned.
